shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce closing screen of {product}, closed and upright, presented as the final gift-ready decision shot. Preserve the exact product identity from the reference image: shape, silhouette, proportions, color, material, surface finish, label/logo placement, and visible construction details. Do not redesign the product. Do not add, remove, or relocate any product feature. Keep the label text exactly legible and unchanged; do not redraw or restyle any logo. {style_lock}. Purpose: echo the opening promise and drive the add-to-cart action. Composition: photographed at eye level from a slight 3/4 angle matching the first frame, the unit centered and upright on a white rounded plinth, nothing clipped. Lighting: soft diffused key from frame upper-left with a gentle rim along the top edge, 5500K, one clean contact shadow grounding the unit. Background: blush-pink field #F9DEDC meeting a clean white lower band #FFFFFF. Props: one thin unprinted ribbon loop beside the base and nothing else. Product occupies 55-60% of the frame. Text zone: the white base band carries one short close line 「{selling_point_12}」 in #2D2D2D at 26pt and one button-shaped element with short rendered copy 「{callout_1}」 in #F58C78. Vertical 2:3 detail-page slice, 2K. Negative: no invented discounts, countdown timers, prices, coupons or sales claims, no packaging box art, no floating product without a contact shadow, no hands, no QR code, no brand mark, no watermark, no cut-off edges.

provenance.notes: 由 8 张详情页切片（panel-01 至 panel-08）拆解为 12 镜漏斗（HERO 开篇、CTA 收口）。品类以图判定：一体式电加热饭盒，L1/L2 按 taxonomy 原文取 家用电器 / 厨房电器，与来源批次文件夹「百货」不一致，故未采用文件夹口径。与库内已有「分体叠胆便携电热饭盒」（jiayongdianqi-cizhi-neidan-dianrefanhe）的差异已在 leafslug 与视觉体系上区隔：本品为无提手、无分体叠胆的一体圆筒密闭腔体，靠微压密封与蒸汽环流加热，内胆为金属而非瓷质，配三色马卡龙外壳；已有款为分体堆叠瓷胆＋提带＋冷灰石台与钢青强调，本款改用圆角马卡龙粉卡片墙、细线圆圈图标、三点记号、冷灰蓝舞台与珊瑚粉光环可视化。已剥离：机身品牌字样与 logo、首屏与分屏全部原案中英文案、色号原案命名、规格表中的品名/材质/尺寸/容量数值、香薰蜡烛标签文字、会员二维码与全店免费促销角标。数值全部脱敏：功率、容量、加热时长、外形尺寸、不锈钢牌号一律以 {callout_*} 占位符或引线表达，画面不落实数；且原图首屏主张与片尾规格表数值互相矛盾（规格表指向另一类保温容器），因此未沿用任何原文数字，信任镜只讲可视构造，不含证书、评分、销量或检测数据。原图无人物出现，本模版亦不引入人脸身份；机位含正面 3/4、高 45 度、90 度侧视、90 度俯视、70 度俯倾微距与低角度仰视，全景镜占比 25%。
